description: Static faction-colored buildings for the Tiny Swords asset pack. Eight building types per palette; each is a single PNG (no animation, no Aseprite source in the pack). Draw on the y-sorted props layer with bottom-centre anchoring; multi-tile footprints block walkers.

sourceFiles.note: Unlike trees, bushes, sheep, and units, the Buildings pack ships exported PNGs only. There is no Buildings.aseprite in the Tiny Swords download.

factionPalettes.rule: Each palette subfolder contains the same eight filenames with identical geometry; only the faction trim color differs. Load path pattern: TinySwords/Buildings/{palette}/{BuildingName}.png

props.order: After ground tiles, cliff bases, stair ramps, and road overlay (when present); before top overlays (clouds, UI). Same layer as trees and other y-sorted props.
props.note: Sort by the placement anchor tile (footprint bottom-centre). Taller south-facing sprites draw on top of sprites further north.

anchoring.rule: Anchor each sprite at bottom-centre: anchorX = spriteWidth / 2, anchorY = spriteHeight. The anchor tile is the bottom-centre cell of the logical footprint.

drawOffset.note: Same formula as trees and sheep in the reference prop renderer.

footprint.rule: Sprite PNG height includes roof and baked ground shadow. The logical footprint (collision / blockedCells) is smaller than the art rectangle and covers only the walkable ground the building occupies.

collision.rule: Every cell in footprintTiles is added to blockedCells. Walkers (sheep, future units) cannot enter those tiles.

onLandOnly.rule: Place only on land (elevation >= 1). All footprint cells must be walkable grass at the same elevation tier. Never on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or ramp cells.
onLandOnly.doNotApply: Water (elevation -1), cliff layer cells, ramp-top / ramp-bottom cells.

flatPreferred.rule: Prefer open interior centre grass (autotile piece 5) with room for the full footprint plus one tile of clearance on each side so roofs and shadows do not clip awkwardly into cliffs or water.

elevationUniform.rule: Every tile under the footprint must share the same elevation. Buildings do not span tier changes.

footprint.note: Small cottage; art is 128px (2 tiles) wide. Shadow extends slightly south of the footprint row.
Tall narrow tower; extra height is visual only above the 2-tile-wide base.
Open-front range building; door faces south toward the viewer.
Tallest standard building (320px). Bell tower and roof extend well above the footprint.
Largest building. Wide rounded curtain walls; central gate faces south. Suitable for map centre or player town hall.
